observations: Multiple solar panels leaning against a wall in an outdoor or workshop setting.
The panels feature monocrystalline cells, identifiable by the dark color and diamond-shaped gaps at cell corners.
Each panel has a 6x12 grid, totaling 72 cells.
No brand names, model numbers, or technical specifications are visible on the front of the panels.
The panels are resting directly on a dirt or concrete floor.

claims.claim: Izutech solar energy specialize in all solar equipment
claims.evidence: This is a general business claim that cannot be verified through a single photo of panels.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's specification sticker on the back of the panel.

risks.risk: Potential for micro-cracks or internal cell damage
risks.proof: A high-resolution close-up of the panel face or an electroluminescence (EL) test result.
Photo of the specification label showing the manufacturer.

proof_requests: Photo of the specification sticker (nameplate) on the back of the panel.
Clear, straight-on photo of the front of a single panel to inspect for glass or cell damage.
response.reason: The wattage and brand, which are the primary determinants of value for solar panels, are not visible. While the 72-cell count suggests a specific size range, the actual power output (Watts) must be confirmed from the manufacturer's label.
